headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Angelico clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.09. For Angelico, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Orange Cassidy was chasing gold for the 20th time. Cassidy retained the AEW International Title against Angelico, whose knee-targeting offense from a recent ROH incident set up the whole match, finishing with the Orange Punch.
That Wednesday in 2021, Bryan Danielson vs. John Silver closed out Dynamite, rated 6.93.

Flash back to 2023, when Bryan Danielson vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 8.21 ? a real highlight of the night. Danielson survived Garcia's hometown crowd and a flurry of chops to lock in the LeBell Lock, extending his unbeaten run through the Continental Classic's Blue League.

secondaries.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Romero & Taylor kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.61.
Looking back to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Riho and Jamie Hayter on Dynamite, rated 7.19 ? a solid showing.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Hobbs & Takeshita made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.27.
